verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting docs say that nothing is sent to Arize and that deployments can be fully air-gapped. That is the product's own documented privacy posture and implies no outbound usage tracking when self-hosted. However, the evidence documents no explicit telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control, and the statement is framed around 'your data' rather than product analytics. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting or env var, documentation of what telemetry (if any) is collected by default, independent verification that no usage data leaves self-hosted instances.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Your data stays entirely within your infrastructure—nothing is sent to Arize and can be fully air-gapped.
